btn_refresh_models_hint: Scan the models folder on the server
hint_gpu_layers: How many layers to offload to the GPU
tip_gpu_layers: Number of model layers loaded into the GPU VRAM. More = faster, but requires memory.
tip_threads: Number of processor threads for generation. Usually equals the number of physical cores.
tip_ctx: Maximum memory amount (in tokens) for the dialogue. Changes automatically depending on the mode.
hint_flash: Speeds up generation and saves VRAM
tip_flash: Speeds up generation and saves VRAM by quantizing the cache.
tip_jinja: REQUIRED for Gemma, Llama 3, Qwen and most modern models.
tip_reasoning_mode: on = always thinks, off = never, auto = per model template.
tip_reasoning_budget: -1 = unlimited, 0 = finish instantly, N > 0 = limit of N tokens.
tip_reasoning_kwargs: JSON string for fine tuning. Example: {"enable_thinking": false}.
tip_reasoning_format: How to return thoughts: deepseek (in reasoning_content), none (in content).
hint_draft_model: Small model with the same tokenizer for acceleration
tip_draft_model: WARNING! The draft tokenizer MUST match the main model. For Qwen2.5-Coder-7B take Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B.
hint_draft_max: How many tokens the draft proposes
tip_draft_max: How many tokens the draft model proposes per step (16 recommended).
draft_warning: ⚠️ Warning: For Draft to work in new llama.cpp versions the flag --spec-type draft-simple will be added automatically. Make sure the draft architecture matches the main model.
tip_moe: Number of expert (MoE) layers kept on CPU.
tip_pooling: Token combination method: mean, cls, last, rank.
confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete the config "{name}"?
alert_models_updated: ✅ The server model list has been updated!
alert_scan_failed: Error while updating the model list
alert_not_running_edit: ⛔ Cannot edit a running server. Press "Stop" first.
err_port_busy_conf: Port {port} is already used by config {file}
reason_port_busy: Port {port} is busy with another server
reason_no_vram: Not enough VRAM (need ~{need} MB, free {free} MB)
reason_no_ram: Not enough RAM (need ~{need} MB, free {free} MB)
guide_html:
📘 User Guide

Welcome to LlamaPanel — a web panel for managing local LLM servers based on llama.cpp.

1. Adding a server

Click "Add server", set the config name, port and the path to the .gguf model (convenient to pick via "Browse"). Choose the run mode and, if needed, configure launch arguments with the "Configure" button.

2. Refreshing the model list

The "Refresh models" button scans the models folder on the server. Run it after adding new .gguf files.

3. Controls

Start / Stop / Restart — control of the server's tmux session. Green dot — server running, yellow — model loading, red — stopped. Dimmed cards mean the server cannot start: the reason is shown on the card (busy port, insufficient VRAM/RAM, missing model file).

4. Editing and deleting

A config can be edited or deleted only when the server is stopped (pencil and trash buttons in the card corner).

5. API

Each server is available as an OpenAI-compatible API at http://<IP>:<port>/v1.

Full documentation — in README.md and the doc/ folder of the repository.
